therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: p53 pathway restoration and prevention of AML relapse
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Acute myeloid leukemia patients post-allogeneic stem cell transplant
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Rate of dose limiting toxicities and maintenance of complete remission without hematologic relapse

safety_signals: Permanent discontinuation due to adverse events in 3/8 participants
results.dose_information: 30 mg/day on days 1-5 of 28-day cycle (starting dose), 10 mg dose also tested

context.duration: 28-day cycles, up to 36 months follow-up planned
context.investigator_commentary: Trial was terminated early due to recruitment challenges, Part 2 combination phase never started
